hookups.source: https://www.ncparks.gov/state-parks/medoc-mountain-state-park ('Full hookup sites with electricity and sewer') + https://northcarolinastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/medoc-mountain-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=NC&parkId=552834 (site list: all 17 electric sites '50 amp', 'Full Hookup available'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Family campground: 17 full-hookup electric sites and 13 non-electric sites, plus 4 cabins, group sites and a horse-only equestrian camp. Every family campsite is a back-in, with listed lengths of 50 to 80 ft.

Booking page: campsites 'can be made for today and can be made up to 6 Month(s) in advance'. Holiday weekends (Memorial Day, July 4th, Labor Day) need 2 nights, cut to 1 night when booking within 14 days of arrival.

booking.source: https://northcarolinastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/medoc-mountain-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=NC&parkId=552834 (Booking Window; 'Business rules for Holiday Weekends'), read 2026-10-20

summary: Fees stand ($30 / full hookup $45 with the $3 fee; the booking table's 2026 and 2027 rates are $27 and $42 before it). Added 50-amp full hookups, 30 back-in family sites up to 80 ft, showers and dump station, 6-month window and the booking site's holiday minimum (waived within 14 days). Not stated: campground season (the park page gives park hours only; the booking site says 'Open year round', a system status not a campground statement), fcfs, max stay, flush toilets.
flags: Registry state:NC min_stay waiver says 7 days; the ReserveAmerica booking site's holiday rule says 14. Recorded 14 here; the agency row may need checking.
